features.quote: Max attempts: 12 test runs or 20 assistant turns, whichever comes first.

if agent explicitly gives up:
        stop(reason="abandoned")

if assistant has 3 consecutive non-tool turns while tests still fail:
        stop(reason="stalled")
Avoid excessively shaming prompts like “failure is unacceptable” as the primary condition
features.justification_quote: they may create an artificial artifact

features.quote: Do not apologize or self-evaluate. Focus on evidence, actions, and blockers.

features.justification_quote: If you reject patches, return neutral feedback

features.quote: A good agent should stop when it has strong evidence of impossibility. Do not penalize that.
